# cssints ui

Styled APG starters over `@cssints/headless` (Solid 2), on one neutral theme.
Behaviour is the npm dependency; a starter adds the component, its sheet and its test.

Install into a Solid 2 + Vite project (see https://ui.cssints.dev for the template):

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add @cssints/<name>
```

Registry: https://packages.cssints.dev/r/{name}.json (index: /r/registry.json)

## Items

- card: A surface and a frame with parts: `Card.Header`, `Card.Body`, `Card.Footer`. `add @cssints/card`
- field: A label, a control, a hint and an error: the ids and the ARIA are `createField`'s. `add @cssints/field`
- dialog: APG modal dialog: a scrim, a panel on the surface, focus in and back, and Escape or the backdrop to close. `add @cssints/dialog`
- input: A text field on the neutral theme, and the control `Field` puts in by default. `add @cssints/input`
- toolbar: A toolbar: `role=toolbar`, a name, and a size the controls inside read as their context. `add @cssints/toolbar`
- button-group: Buttons in one line: the corners two neighbours share and the border between them are the group's, not a prop's. `add @cssints/button-group`
- switch: APG switch on @cssints/headless, on the neutral theme, with its scenario test. `add @cssints/switch`
- disclosure: APG disclosure on @cssints/headless, on the neutral theme, with its scenario test. `add @cssints/disclosure`
- button: APG button and toggle button: `tone` and `size` variants, and `render` for a link. `add @cssints/button`
- checkbox: APG checkbox, including the mixed tri-state, on @cssints/headless. `add @cssints/checkbox`
- radio: APG radio group with roving tabindex or aria-activedescendant focus. `add @cssints/radio`
- tabs: APG tabs: roving tabindex, automatic or manual activation, wrapped arrows. `add @cssints/tabs`
- accordion: APG accordion: multiple or single expansion, headed triggers, collapsible. `add @cssints/accordion`
- separator: A rule between two groups: `role=separator` with its orientation, or a decorative `role=none`. `add @cssints/separator`
- badge: A small label in three tones, a pill at 999px because the theme's steps stop at 16px. `add @cssints/badge`
- skeleton: A placeholder box that pulses only when the reader has not asked for less motion. `add @cssints/skeleton`
- alert: APG alert: a title and a body in a live region, with an `invalid` tone. `add @cssints/alert`
- meter: APG meter: a track and the fill of the value, on `createMeter`. `add @cssints/meter`
- breadcrumb: APG breadcrumb: a trail whose current page is marked `aria-current=page` and painted from it. `add @cssints/breadcrumb`
- treeview: APG tree view: roving focus, expanded rows and levels on `createTreeview`. `add @cssints/treeview`
- menu: APG menu button: one trigger, a list with a roving tab stop, arrows, Home and End, Escape and a click outside to close; a variant gives the rows checkbox and radio items. `add @cssints/menu`
- menubar: APG menu and menubar: a roving bar whose menus float under their items, rows with one tab stop, and nested submenus that open beside the parent row. `add @cssints/menubar`
- tooltip: APG tooltip: a text bubble on hover and on focus, wired to its trigger by `aria-describedby`. `add @cssints/tooltip`
- select: APG select-only combobox: the button that shows the chosen label is the combobox, a floating listbox follows it with `aria-activedescendant`, and Enter, Tab or a click commits. `add @cssints/select`
- textarea: A multi-line field styled like `Input`, and the control `Field` puts in with `render`. `add @cssints/textarea`
- slider: APG slider: the rail, the fill and the thumb, with the fill's share of the rail from `aria-valuenow`. `add @cssints/slider`
- slider-multithumb: APG multi-thumb slider: two thumbs whose bounds follow each other, and the interval between them as the fill. `add @cssints/slider-multithumb`
- spinbutton: APG spinbutton: a number field with steppers it disables at the bounds, and the id a `Field` names it by. `add @cssints/spinbutton`
- checkbox-group: APG tri-state checkbox group: three of the kit's `Checkbox`, and the all/none/mixed parent derived from them. `add @cssints/checkbox-group`
- theme: the neutral theme as plain custom properties; arrives with any starter

## How a component is written

A component is one `.tsx`: styles are `cn()`/`cv()` with the theme's tokens, states are the ARIA
attributes the widget announces (`attr()`, `within()`), and `render` replaces a part with another
component or tag. A copy needs `cssints` in the project's Vite config; `theme.ts` and `tokens.ts`
arrive with it, and `theme.css` is the same theme for a project without the plugin. The
combinations are checked in `src/registry/combos.browser.test.tsx`.
